name: Armd Div Advance: broad front, two Bdes
note: An Armd Div advancing on a broad front with two Bdes after the break-out (OoW Vol II pp 52-53: 'should preferably advance on a broad front with two brigades. Each brigade can either advance with two regiment groups up or with one regiment group'); in the desert on a very wide front, on multiple axes, by combat groups (DW pp 35, 55). The click is the Div SP line's centre; the aim is the direction of advance. The Lt Bde with two Regt groups up, the Rt Bde with one (both options shown); the axes 5 km apart (E: no figure printed, PlanDoctrine advance.div.axesApartM 3-8 km); covering troops 4-8 km ahead on each axis and the Div's flank guards 15-20 km out (OoW Vol II Fig 2 p 9); Div Tac between the axes; the follow-up Bde about 8 km behind (Fig 2's note, its reading uncertain). With the terrain each axis is routed for tracks and read for its going and water crossings; each Bde's report lines, halting areas and march are built with the Armd Bde advance on its axis.
